messages:
Aisha R.: Hey folks — planning parental leave starting 2026-08-15. Can I layer my remaining vacation to extend beyond the company-paid window?
Tom (People Ops): Yes, you can. Please indicate on the Parental Leave form whether you want PTO applied or paid out. If applied, it counts as continuous service. Looping in Nina for benefits/proration details.
Nina (Benefits): Applying PTO keeps coverage active; premiums may be prorated for partial-pay periods. If you move to temporary reduced FTE on return, let us know dates so we can calculate employer contribution changes (HSA/401k deferrals).
Aisha R.: Thinking of staying 0.9 FTE for 2 weeks after coming back to ease transition. Will that affect the health plan or dental?
Raj - Eng Mgr: From team side, 0.9 for a short period is fine. Ill update schedules and on-call. Please give me the exact dates when you submit.
Nina (Benefits): Short reduction like that usually maintains active coverage; payroll will prorate employee/employer premiums. We need the exact payroll periods to confirm.
Aisha R.: Any special docs to attach?
Tom (People Ops): Use the Parental Leave workflow in the HR portal, add comment "PTO applied" and upload a screenshot of PTO balance if you want. For temporary FTE changes, sign the FTE amendment form (we have a template).
Payroll Bot: Reminder: submit leave+PTO combinations before the payroll cutoff to ensure correct gross/pay coding. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/leave-forms
Aisha R.: Thanks all — submitting now with dates 2026-08-15 to 2026-09-12 (6w company-paid, then 1w PTO applied, then 1w unpaid). Also attaching 0.9 FTE amendment for 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-26.
Tom (People Ops): Got it — Ill route to Payroll & Benefits and follow up if anything else is needed. Congrats in advance! :tada:
